nodes.description: Ownable._owner: private address holding the contract owner; set to msg.sender in the constructor and changed by _transferOwnership/renounceOwnership.
ETCA.name: ERC20 token name, set once in the constructor from the _name parameter.
ETCA.symbol: ERC20 token symbol, set once in the constructor from the _symbol parameter.
ETCA.decimals: uint8 token decimals, default 18, overwritten in the constructor from _decimals.
ETCA.totalSupply: total token supply; set in constructor, increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
ETCA.frozenAccount mapping(address=>bool): accounts blocked by the owner via freezeAccount; checked in transfer/transferFrom.
ETCA.balanceOf mapping(address=>uint256): token balances mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
ETCA._allowance nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)): private spend allowances mutated by _approve.
Ownable constructor: assigns msg.sender to _owner and emits OwnershipTransferred.
onlyOwner modifier: requires isOwner() before executing the guarded body.
isOwner(): returns msg.sender == _owner; the access-control predicate used by onlyOwner.
renounceOwnership(): onlyOwner function that sets _owner to address(0).
transferOwnership(address): onlyOwner function that delegates to _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership(address newOwner): internal ownership transfer with zero-address check and event.
owner(): public view returning _owner.
ETCA constructor: sets decimals, computes totalSupply with unchecked multiplication, credits msg.sender and stores name/symbol.
freezeAccount(address,bool): onlyOwner function writing to frozenAccount and emitting FrozenFunds.
transfer(address,uint256): external transfer that checks sender/recipient freeze status and calls _transfer.
allowance(address,address): view returning _allowance[owner][spender].
approve(address,uint256): sets allowance for msg.sender via _approve.
transferFrom(address,address,uint256): freeze checks, _transfer and allowance decrement through SafeMath.sub.
increase_allowance(address,uint256): adds to msg.sender allowance via SafeMath.add and _approve.
decrease_allowance(address,uint256): subtracts from msg.sender allowance via SafeMath.sub and _approve.
mint(address,uint256): onlyOwner entry point calling _mint.
burn(uint256): public entry point burning msg.sender balance via _burn.
burnFrom(address,uint256): public entry point calling _burnFrom.
_transfer(address,address,uint256): internal balance mutation using SafeMath.add/sub and Transfer event.
_mint(address,uint256): internal supply and balance increase using SafeMath.add.
_burn(address,uint256): internal balance and supply decrease using SafeMath.sub.
_approve(address,address,uint256): internal allowance write with zero-address checks and Approval event.
_burnFrom(address,uint256): internal burn plus allowance decrease for msg.sender.
kill(): onlyOwner function executing selfdestruct(msg.sender), destroying the contract.
Fallback function: external payable that always reverts, blocking plain Ether transfers.
SafeMath.add(uint256,uint256): checked addition returning c.
SafeMath.sub(uint256,uint256): checked subtraction using require(b <= a).
SafeMath.sub(uint256,uint256,string): subtraction overload with custom error message.
SafeMath.mul(uint256,uint256): checked multiplication with require(c / a == b).
SafeMath.div(uint256,uint256): division delegating to the message overload.
SafeMath.div(uint256,uint256,string): checked division with require(b > 0).
SafeMath.mod(uint256,uint256): modulo delegating to the message overload.
SafeMath.mod(uint256,uint256,string): checked modulo with require(b != 0).
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller address used as owner, sender, approver, minter/burner and selfdestruct beneficiary.
selfdestruct(msg.sender) inside kill(): irreversible destruction of the contract and forwarding of its balance to the owner.
Unchecked arithmetic in the ETCA constructor: _initialSupply * 10 ** uint256(_decimals) is computed without SafeMath, allowing silent overflow of totalSupply.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written directly into the privileged _owner state variable by the Ownable constructor.
isOwner compares the untrusted msg.sender against _owner, producing the access-control decision used by onlyOwner.
transfer uses msg.sender as the debited sender account.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner via _approve.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
burn passes msg.sender as the account being burned in _burn.
transfer/transferFrom index frozenAccount with the untrusted msg.sender to gate the transfer.
selfdestruct(msg.sender) sends the entire contract balance to the untrusted caller.
onlyOwner requires isOwner() before any guarded function body executes.
freezeAccount is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
mint is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
kill is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
kill executes the privileged destructive selfdestruct operation.
freezeAccount writes the freeze flag into frozenAccount[target].
transfer delegates the balance mutation to _transfer.
transfer requires the sender and recipient accounts to be unfrozen before proceeding.
transferFrom calls _transfer to move tokens from sender to recipient.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrement the spender allowance.
transferFrom requires sender and recipient freeze flags to be false.
approve calls _approve to write the allowance table.
increase_allowance calls _approve with the additive result.
decrease_allowance calls _approve with the subtractive result.
mint delegates supply creation to _mint.
burn delegates balance destruction to _burn for msg.sender.
burnFrom delegates to _burnFrom.
_burnFrom calls _burn on the target account.
_burnFrom calls _approve to reduce the caller allowance after burning.
transferOwnership delegates to the internal _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership overwrites the privileged _owner address.
Ownable constructor initialises the privileged _owner field.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0), permanently dropping owner privileges.
_transfer credits and debits the balanceOf mapping.
_transfer relies on SafeMath.sub for the sender balance reduction.
_mint increases the totalSupply state variable.
_mint increases balanceOf[account].
_mint uses SafeMath.add for supply and balance math.
_burn decreases balanceOf[account] using SafeMath.sub.
_burn decreases the totalSupply state variable.
_approve writes the private _allowance nested mapping.
The ETCA constructor computes _initialSupply * 10 ** _decimals without SafeMath, feeding the unsafe multiplication operation.
The constructor assigns the scaled token amount to totalSupply.
The constructor credits the entire supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
The constructor stores _decimals into the decimals state variable.
The constructor stores _name into the name state variable.
The constructor stores _symbol into the symbol state variable.
The unchecked multiplication result is written into totalSupply, so overflow silently corrupts supply.
Transfer event emission and hook ordering follow the internal _transfer call sequence, which is the state-mutation point to audit for reentrancy.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter recipient only describes the transfer(address,uint256) signature and is fully absorbed by that function node.
Parameter amount only feeds the transfer(address,uint256) body and carries no independent semantics.
newOwner is only meaningful inside transferOwnership(address) and should be merged into it.
target is the sole input of freezeAccount(address,bool) and is subsumed by the function node.
freeze is a scalar flag used only inside freezeAccount(address,bool).
spender is a signature-only parameter of approve(address,uint256).
amount is a signature-only parameter of approve(address,uint256).
sender is used only within transferFrom(address,address,uint256).
recipient is used only within transferFrom(address,address,uint256).
amount is used only within transferFrom(address,address,uint256).
spender parameter belongs exclusively to increase_allowance(address,uint256).
addedValue parameter belongs exclusively to increase_allowance(address,uint256).
spender parameter belongs exclusively to decrease_allowance(address,uint256).
subtractedValue parameter belongs exclusively to decrease_allowance(address,uint256).
account is the minting target and only has meaning inside mint(address,uint256).
amount is the minted quantity and only has meaning inside mint(address,uint256).
amount is the burned quantity and only has meaning inside burn(uint256).
account is the burn target and only has meaning inside burnFrom(address,uint256).
amount is the burned quantity and only has meaning inside burnFrom(address,uint256).
_initialSupply is the left operand of the unchecked multiplication in the constructor and is directly tied to that unsafe operation.
_name is a pure constructor argument stored into the name state variable.
_symbol is a pure constructor argument stored into the symbol state variable.
_decimals is used as the exponent 10 ** _decimals in the unchecked multiplication, directly tying it to that unsafe operation.
